## Notes

All four rollouts (base1, inv1, dom1, agg1) executed the same code and produced identical reasoning and answers (ANSWER: No). The candidates were not edits; they were re-runs of an unchanged harness. Token consumption varied (2589, 2630, 2319, 3778), but this is stochastic variation in model behavior under the same input, not an effect of harness modifications. The decisions for each candidate correctly noted the absence of failures, divergences, or repeated errors, and concluded that the simple single-call design needed no adaptation. The adoption of agg1 was driven by its trivial pool status (single final at k=1) rather than any evidence of superiority. Since no candidate proposed or tested any edit, no trajectory contrast exists to establish what any modification would do.
